generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of vegetable garden and greenhouse (菜园与温室). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Show a productive allotment garden from the open doorway of one glass greenhouse. The greenhouse structure fills the upper frame while one raised bed leads through the middle. Train a tomato vine and a cucumber plant on separate supports, making their fruit and leaves visually distinct. Place the seedling tray on a potting bench and the compost bin outside at the rear. In the clean foreground, separate the garden fork, closed secateurs and kneeler; one support cane remains visibly attached to the tomato vine. Warm morning sun, realistic soil and glass reflections, no baskets of loose vegetables and no repeated hand tools.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: glass greenhouse, raised vegetable bed, tomato vine, cucumber plant, seedling tray, compost bin, garden fork, secateurs, plant support cane, garden kneeler.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
